session_1.speaker: Elena
session_1.text: I finally restored the vintage ceramic kiln at the Riverbend Art Co-op this morning.

session_1.speaker: Marcus
session_1.text: Nice! My sister Nora just moved to Portland to work as a botanical illustrator.

session_1.speaker: Elena
session_1.text: That sounds wonderful. By the way, I adopted a mischievous orange tabby cat named Miso last week.

session_1.speaker: Marcus
session_1.text: Cute name! I have been training for a half marathon along the Cedar Creek Trail.

session_2.speaker: Elena
session_2.text: My kiln glaze test worked using cobalt oxide for a deep ocean blue finish.

session_2.speaker: Marcus
session_2.text: Awesome! I booked a train ticket for 12 April, 2024 to visit my sister Nora in the city where she works.

session_2.speaker: Elena
session_2.text: Miso knocked over a teacup on the porch, so I moved all my ceramic mugs to the high oak pantry cabinet out of reach of my cat.

session_2.speaker: Marcus
session_2.text: Smart move. I started taking classical guitar lessons on Tuesday evenings.

session_3.speaker: Elena
session_3.text: How was your spring trip? I reserved a pottery market booth for 18 May, 2024.

session_3.speaker: Marcus
session_3.text: Visiting Portland was great—Nora and I sketched ferns at the conservatory and bought roasted hazelnut coffee.

session_3.speaker: Elena
session_3.text: I finished glazing fourteen stoneware bowls for the upcoming May craft market.

session_3.speaker: Marcus
session_3.text: My guitar teacher asked me to practice Villa-Lobos Etude No. 1 before next Tuesday.

session_4.speaker: Elena
session_4.text: I packed the fourteen stoneware bowls into wooden crates labeled ELENA-KILN-09.

session_4.speaker: Marcus
session_4.text: I ran the Cedar Creek Trail half marathon and finished in 1 hour 52 minutes on 4 May, 2024.

session_4.speaker: Elena
session_4.text: Congrats! I am driving to the Riverbend Art Co-op early Saturday to arrange the display shelves.

session_4.speaker: Marcus
session_4.text: I will bring folding tables and some roasted hazelnut coffee for the morning setup.

session_1.speaker: Devon

session_4.speaker: Devon
